label: step-005
payload: Write a Python script called 'apply_renames.py' that reads 'renames.csv' and applies each old-to-new pair as a whole-word rename to both 'billing.py' and 'tests/test_billing.py' — reading each file's text, substituting every pair, and writing it back — then run it with python3 using the Bash tool (not the context-mode MCP sandbox). The script must read the mapping from 'renames.csv' (not hardcode it) and must update the test file with the new names too. Important: perform the rename by writing and running that script — do NOT use your Edit/Write tools to change 'billing.py' or its test file directly.
